title: Flatten Binary Tree to Linked List
goal: Solve Flatten Binary Tree to Linked List: Morris-style: at each node, find the rightmost node of the left subtree and attach the right subtree there.
strategy: Morris-style: at each node, find the rightmost node of the left subtree and attach the right subtree there.
edgeCases: Save the original right subtree before rewiring left links; the final chain must preserve preorder and clear every left pointer.
inputRules: Use at most 200 nodes for this pointer trace.
